description.zh: 为离线 Minecraft 服务器提供自定义皮肤托管的 Web 应用（Laravel 10 + React 前端）：账号体系、材质上传与渲染公开接口、角色/衣橱管理、插件系统与后台。
description.en: Web application that hosts custom skins for offline Minecraft servers (Laravel 10 + React): accounts, texture upload/rendering APIs, player & closet management, plugin system and admin panel.

description.zh: 管理面板：仪表盘与统计图表、用户与角色管理、举报审核、选项配置页面（站点/积分/资源）、翻译与版本更新入口。
description.en: Admin panel: dashboard and charts, user and player management, report moderation, option pages (site/score/resource), translation and version-update entries.

description.zh: 管理面板首页：使用量/通知/图表小组件与数据接口（chart/status），前端加载图表并轮询状态。
description.en: Admin home: usage/notification/chart widgets and data endpoints (chart/status); the front end loads charts and polls status.

description.zh: 四组后台表单：自定义样式与脚本、积分规则、站点信息与资源限制，均由 OptionForm 声明式构建。
description.en: Four admin forms — custom styles/scripts, score rules, site info and resource limits — all built declaratively with OptionForm.

description.zh: 用户举报材质（理由+证据图）与管理员审核：通过下架并处罚、驳回返还积分。
description.en: User texture reports (reason + evidence image) and admin review: approve to delist and penalize, reject to refund score.

description.zh: 审核队列：查看证据、标记通过/驳回，通过时按规则下架材质、扣分或奖励举报人。
description.en: Review queue: view evidence, approve or reject; approval delists the texture and applies score penalties/rewards per rules.

description.zh: 登录用户提交举报（材质、理由、证据图），可追踪自己举报的处理进度。
description.en: Signed-in users submit reports (texture, reason, evidence image) and track the progress of their own reports.

description.zh: 检查 GitHub 最新版本、展示可用更新、下载压缩包并解压覆盖，仅超管可用。
description.en: Checks GitHub for the latest release, shows available updates, downloads and extracts over the install; super-admin only.

description.zh: 用户列表与逐项操作：邮箱、验证状态、昵称、密码、积分、权限与删除，前端为表格与卡片。
description.en: User list and per-user operations: email, verification, nickname, password, score, permission and delete; the front end uses tables and cards.

description.zh: 重置密码、调整积分、变更权限等级与删除用户（删除会级联清理角色与衣橱）。
description.en: Reset password, adjust score, change permission level and delete users (deleting cascades to players and closet).

description.zh: 修改用户邮箱、验证状态与昵称，操作后广播资料更新事件。
description.en: Edit user email, verification state and nickname, firing profile-updated events afterwards.

description.zh: 分页查询全站用户（可搜索），渲染管理表格头部与加载骨架。
description.en: Paginated query of all users (searchable), rendering the table header and loading skeletons.

description.zh: 插件可用的全部扩展入口：Hook 静态门面（菜单/路由/资源/徽章/通知）、内置事件目录与事件-监听器映射。
description.en: All extension entry points available to plugins: the Hook facade (menu/route/asset/badge/notification), the built-in event catalog and the event-to-listener mapping.

description.zh: EventServiceProvider：声明事件-监听器映射（含插件 versionChanged 等通配事件）并观察 Scope 模型刷新缓存。
description.en: EventServiceProvider: declares the event-to-listener map (including wildcard plugin events) and observes Scope to refresh the cache.

description.zh: 插件扩展入口：菜单/路由/样式/脚本/徽章/通知/中间件七类静态方法，本质是监听内置事件并按位置插入。
description.en: Plugin extension entry points: menu/route/style/script/badge/notification/middleware static methods, listening on built-in events and inserting by position.

description.zh: 对内置事件的响应逻辑：材质/衣橱联动维护、插件资源与本地化同步、邮件验证与语言应用。
description.en: Responses to built-in events: texture/closet maintenance, plugin asset and locale sync, mail verification and locale application.

description.zh: 插件启用/升级时拷贝静态资源到 public/plugins 并清理前端语言缓存；启动失败时向管理员发送通知。
description.en: On plugin enable/upgrade: copy assets to public/plugins and clear the front-end locale cache; on boot failure, notify the admin.

description.zh: 材质删除/私有化后：清理衣橱、复位角色皮肤披风、返还积分；衣橱项被移除时复位对应角色。
description.en: After texture delete/privacy change: clean closets, reset player skins/capes and refund score; reset players when a closet item is removed.

description.zh: 注册完成后发送验证邮件，登录认证成功后应用用户语言偏好。
description.en: Sends the verification mail after registration and applies the user locale after authentication.

description.zh: 内置事件类全集，按领域分组：菜单/路由扩展、渲染挂载点、用户、角色、插件与材质生命周期。
description.en: All built-in event classes, grouped by domain: menu/route extensions, render mount points, user, player, plugin and texture lifecycles.

description.zh: ConfigureAdminMenu / ConfigureUserMenu / ConfigureExploreMenu / ConfigureRoutes：让插件往三套菜单和路由表注入条目。
description.en: ConfigureAdminMenu / ConfigureUserMenu / ConfigureExploreMenu / ConfigureRoutes: let plugins inject entries into the three menus and the route table.

description.zh: 角色增删改查全周期：新增前/后、删除前/后、资料更新与读取，供插件同步到其他系统。
description.en: Player CRUD lifecycle: pre/post add, pre/post delete, profile updated and retrieved, for plugins to sync with other systems.

description.zh: 插件启用/禁用/删除/启动失败事件，触发资源拷贝、前端语言清理与失败告警。
description.en: Plugin enabled/disabled/deleted/boot-failed events, triggering asset copying, front-end locale cleanup and failure alerts.

description.zh: RenderingHeader / RenderingFooter / RenderingBadges / TextureDeleting：插件向页头页脚、材质徽章注入内容或在删除前拦截。
description.en: RenderingHeader / RenderingFooter / RenderingBadges / TextureDeleting: inject into header/footer/badges or intercept before texture deletion.

description.zh: 注册、登录尝试、登录成功、认证、资料更新事件，是邮件验证、本地化等监听的锚点。
description.en: Registration, login attempt, logged-in, authenticated and profile-updated events; anchors for mail verification and localization listeners.

description.zh: 统一异常渲染：JSON/AJAX 与页面两套响应、PrettyPageException 友好错误页、403/404/500/503 模板。
description.en: Unified exception rendering: JSON/AJAX and full-page responses, the PrettyPageException friendly error page, and 403/404/500/503 templates.

description.zh: 统一异常出口：判断 AJAX/JSON 请求返回结构化错误体，否则渲染 PrettyPage 或 403/404/500/503 错误页，并处理 CSRF 过期与会话丢失。
description.en: Unified exception outlet: returns structured JSON for AJAX/JSON requests, otherwise renders the PrettyPage or 403/404/500/503 pages, handling expired CSRF and lost sessions.

description.zh: 403/404/500/503 与 pretty 调试错误页模板，附带语言切换与版权信息。
description.en: 403/404/500/503 and the pretty debug error page templates, with language switcher and copyright fragments.

description.zh: TypeScript + React 前端：入口引导与客户端路由、网络层、i18n/事件总线、通用组件库、各页面视图、终端 CLI 与样式系统。
description.en: TypeScript + React front end: bootstrap and client-side routing, HTTP layer, i18n/event bus, shared component library, page views, terminal CLI and the style system.

description.zh: 页面内 xterm 终端：Shell 会话、包管理/衣橱/删除等命令与插件管理器桥接。
description.en: In-page xterm terminal: shell sessions, package/closet/remove commands and the plugin-manager bridge.

description.zh: 内置命令：apt/dnf/pacman 包管理、rm 删除、closet 衣橱操作，与前端网络层联动。
description.en: Built-in commands: apt/dnf/pacman package managers, rm and closet operations, wired to the front-end HTTP layer.

description.zh: xterm 挂载、Draggable 窗口、Spinner 与 readline/stdio 配置，复用 blessing-skin-shell 的 Shell。
description.en: xterm mount, draggable window, spinner and readline/stdio setup, reusing the Shell from blessing-skin-shell.

description.zh: 页面共用的 React 组件：模态框、分页、预览器、反馈与表单控件。
description.en: Reusable React components across pages: modals, pagination, previewer, feedback and form controls.

description.zh: Toast 通知、Alert 提示与 Loading 骨架三类反馈。
description.en: Toast notifications, Alert hints and Loading skeletons.

description.zh: 文件选择、邮箱建议、验证码、暗色模式开关与编辑按钮等表单控件。
description.en: File input, email suggestion, captcha, dark-mode toggle and edit-button controls.

description.zh: 模态框组合（Modal/Header/Body/Footer/Content/Input），用于确认、告警与表单嵌入。
description.en: Modal family (Modal/Header/Body/Footer/Content/Input) for confirmations, alerts and embedded forms.

description.zh: 分页条与页码项组件，配合后端分页响应渲染。
description.en: Pagination bar and page-item components, rendering against back-end paginated responses.

description.zh: SkinView3D 三维预览与骨架屏，用于皮肤/披风展示。
description.en: SkinView3D 3D previewer and skeleton, used for skin/cape display.

description.zh: 通用 hooks：挂载/尺寸/纹理加载/tween 动画/blessing extra 读取。
description.en: Shared hooks: mount, screen size, texture loading, tween animation and blessing extra access.

description.zh: 单页启动与基础设施：入口引导、客户端路由、网络层、事件总线/i18n 与全局类型。
description.en: SPA boot and infrastructure: entry bootstrap, client-side routing, HTTP layer, event bus/i18n and global types.

description.zh: ReactDOM 挂载入口：装配 webpack 公共路径、挂载全局对象、按路由表懒加载页面组件、注册 CLI 入口。
description.en: ReactDOM mount entry: sets the webpack public path, exposes globals, lazy-loads page components per the route table and registers the CLI entry.

description.zh: walkFetch 封装：自动附带 CSRF token、统一解析响应/校验错误/异常追踪并弹错误框；get/post/put/del 便捷方法。
description.en: walkFetch wrapper: attaches the CSRF token, normalizes response/validation errors/exception traces with error modals; get/post/put/del helpers.

description.zh: 后端路由 URL 构建器
按 path 正则匹配页面，声明对应 React 组件、挂载点与骨架帧，以及需预加载的模块。
description.en: Matches pages by path regex, declaring the React component, mount point, skeleton frame and modules to preload.

description.zh: 前端事件总线（on/emit）、i18n 翻译函数（blessing.i18n 查找）、全局类型定义（User/Player/Texture）与插件扩展入口 extra。
description.en: Front-end event bus (on/emit), the i18n translate function over blessing.i18n, global types (User/Player/Texture) and the plugin extra entry.

description.zh: 页面级交互脚本：暗色模式、登出、通知轮询、Toast/模态框辅助、邮箱验证与材质工具函数。
description.en: Page-level interaction scripts: dark mode, logout, notification polling, toast/modal helpers, email verification and texture utils.

description.zh: 全局/后台/认证/首页/spectre/下拉等 CSS 与断点工具、Minecraft 字体。
description.en: Global/admin/auth/home/spectre/dropdown CSS with breakpoint utilities and the Minecraft font.

description.zh: 请求入口层：HTTP 内核与中间件栈装配、三套路由表（web/api/静态资源）的注册、中间件与视图组合器。
description.en: Request entry layer: HTTP kernel and middleware stack, registration of the three route tables (web/api/static assets), middleware and view composers.

description.zh: 把站点选项、菜单、通知、语言列表等数据注入 Twig 视图，是模板层与选项/插件系统的粘合层。
description.en: Injects site options, menus, notifications and language lists into Twig views; the glue between the template layer and the option/plugin systems.

description.zh: 向 shared.foot 注入脚本文件、内联 extra 片段与全局序列化数据，并在调试栏启用时追加调试资源。
description.en: Injects script files, inline extra snippets and serialized globals into shared.foot, appending debug assets when the debug bar is enabled.

description.zh: 向 shared.head 注入 favicon、主题色、SEO 元信息、样式文件与全局 JS 变量（插件可经 Hook 追加）。
description.en: Injects favicon, theme color, SEO metadata, style files and global JS variables into shared.head (plugins can append via Hook).

description.zh: 组装侧边菜单（用户/后台/探索，含插件配置入口）、用户头像下拉与语言切换菜单的数据。
description.en: Builds the sidebar menu (user/admin/explore, including plugin config entries), the user avatar dropdown and the language switcher data.

description.zh: 定义全局中间件、web/api/authorize 中间件组与中间件别名，是所有请求进入应用的总闸门。
description.en: Defines global middleware, the web/api/authorize middleware groups and middleware aliases; the single gate every request passes through.

description.zh: 中间件分组与别名定义
请求生命周期上的横切逻辑：安装状态闸门、登录与封禁拦截、邮箱验证与角色权限、语言偏好探测。
description.en: Cross-cutting request lifecycle logic: installation gate, authentication and ban interception, email verification and role checks, locale detection.

description.zh: verified 角色必须已激活、authorize 组内强制补齐邮箱，role 别名按等级（admin/super-admin）放行后台路由。
description.en: The verified alias requires an activated account, the authorize group forces a filled email, and the role alias gates admin routes by level (admin/super-admin).

description.zh: authorize 中间件组：登录校验与重定向、已登录用户禁止访问访客页、封禁用户拦截、登录后广播 UserAuthenticated。
description.en: The authorize group: authentication check and redirect, guest-page guard for signed-in users, banned-user rejection, and the UserAuthenticated event after login.

description.zh: 未安装时把请求重定向到安装向导并在无锁时禁用翻译加载，安装向导路由本身则放行；已安装后阻止再次进入向导。
description.en: Redirects to the install wizard when not installed and disables translation loading without the lock file; the wizard routes themselves pass through, and re-entry is blocked once installed.

description.zh: 未安装重定向与升级触发
description.en: Redirect to setup and trigger upgrade

name.zh: 请求预处理与维护模式

description.zh: 全局中间件：空字符串转 null、浏览器语言偏好探测、旧浏览器（EverGreen）拦截与维护模式提示。
description.en: Global middleware: empty-string-to-null conversion, browser locale detection, and the EverGreen (outdated browser) block with maintenance notice.

description.zh: 三套路由表及其装载：带会话的 web、无状态的 api（含 throttle 与 Passport 作用域）、免会话的静态资源与材质公开接口。
description.en: The three route tables and their loading: session-based web, stateless api (with throttle and Passport scopes), and session-free static/texture public endpoints.

description.zh: 面向第三方应用的 REST 接口：用户、通知、角色、衣橱及管理类接口，按 Passport scope 授权。
description.en: REST endpoints for third-party apps: user, notifications, players, closet and admin APIs, authorized by Passport scopes.

description.zh: API 路由定义与作用域绑定
description.en: API route definitions and scope binding

description.zh: 按 web/api/static 依次 map 路由文件，给 Passport 自带路由补上登录与邮箱验证中间件，最后广播 ConfigureRoutes 事件供插件追加路由。
description.en: Maps the web/api/static route files in order, hardens Passport routes with auth and verified middleware, and finally fires ConfigureRoutes so plugins can add routes.

description.zh: 路由装载与插件路由扩展点
description.en: Route loading and the plugin route extension point

description.zh: 无需会话的高频接口：{player}.json 材质清单、textures/{hash}、raw/{tid}、avatar/* 与 preview/* 渲染入口。
description.en: Session-free high-traffic endpoints: {player}.json manifests, textures/{hash}, raw/{tid}, and avatar/* plus preview/* rendering entries.

description.zh: 静态资源与渲染路由定义
全部带会话页面与后台表单路由：首页、认证、用户中心、材质、皮肤库、后台、安装向导。
description.en: All session-based page and admin form routes: home, auth, user center, textures, skin library, admin panel and the install wizard.

description.zh: 站点多语言：YAML 语言包加载、前端 i18n 表生成与缓存清理、浏览器语言偏好探测、语言列表与后台翻译词条管理。
description.en: Site localization: YAML language pack loading, front-end i18n table generation and cache cleanup, browser locale detection, language menus and admin translation management.

description.zh: 后台翻译管理：列出/新增/修改/删除语言包词条，写入对应语言 YAML 文件并失效前端缓存。
description.en: Admin translation management: list/create/update/delete language-pack entries, writing the YAML files and invalidating the front-end cache.

description.zh: 请求时按浏览器/会话偏好选择语言，登录成功后应用用户语言设置，切换语言后清理前端语言缓存。
description.en: Chooses the locale per request from browser/session preferences, applies the user locale after login, and clears the front-end cache on switch.

description.zh: 13 种语言的 YAML 语言包（admin/auth/skinlib/user 等分组）与 overrides 覆盖目录。
description.en: YAML language packs for 13 locales (admin/auth/skinlib/user groups) plus the overrides directory.

description.zh: YAML 语言包加载（含 overrides 覆盖机制）、按语言组读取，以及生成前端 window.i18n 数据并管理缓存失效。
description.en: YAML language pack loading (with overrides), per-group reads, and generation of the front-end window.i18n table with cache invalidation.

description.zh: 应用引导与配置、数据库迁移、安装向导与版本升级、构建工具链（webpack/tsconfig/urls 生成）、Docker/CI 与测试套件。
description.en: Application bootstrap and configuration, database migrations, install wizard and version upgrades, build toolchain (webpack/tsconfig/url generation), Docker/CI and the test suite.

description.zh: 入口文件：bootstrap/app.php 创建应用实例、public/index.php 处理 Web 请求、artisan 控制台入口与 server.php 兼容入口。
description.en: Entry points: bootstrap/app.php creates the app, public/index.php handles web requests, artisan is the console entry, and server.php is a compat entry.

description.zh: Webpack/TypeScript/ESLint/Prettier 配置、URL 生成与 HTML 增强工具、依赖清单。
description.en: Webpack/TypeScript/ESLint/Prettier configs, URL generation and HTML enhancement tools, and dependency manifests.

description.zh: composer.json（PHP 依赖与脚本）与 package.json（前端依赖与脚本）及锁文件。
description.en: composer.json (PHP deps and scripts) and package.json (front-end deps and scripts) with their lock files.

description.zh: generateUrls.ts 从路由表生成前端 URL 构建器（带参数类型推导），并 prettier 格式化输出。
description.en: generateUrls.ts generates the front-end URL builders (with parameter type inference) from the route table, formatted by prettier.

description.zh: 多入口构建（app/style/home/spectre）与开发服务器：ts-loader、MiniCssExtract、HTML 增强插件与 CDN 公共路径。
description.en: Multi-entry build (app/style/home/spectre) and dev server: ts-loader, MiniCssExtract, HTML enhancement plugin and CDN public path.

description.zh: Artisan 命令注册与全部自定义命令：安装、升级、选项缓存、盐生成、插件启停。
description.en: Artisan command registration and all custom commands: install, update, options cache, salt generation and plugin toggles.

description.zh: 命令行执行安装并创建超管（bs:install {email} {password} {nickname}），等价于向导的收尾步骤。
description.en: Runs installation from the CLI and creates the super admin (bs:install {email} {password} {nickname}); equivalent to the wizard finish step.

description.zh: 注册自定义命令与 Passport keys 命令，无计划任务调度。
description.en: Registers custom commands and the Passport keys command; no scheduled tasks.

description.zh: artisan options:cache：把 options.php 站点选项写入缓存，加快读取。
description.en: artisan options:cache: caches the options.php site options for faster reads.

description.zh: artisan salt:random：生成并写入 .env 的密码盐值，支持 --show 仅显示。
description.en: artisan salt:random: generates and writes the password salt into .env, with a --show flag.

description.zh: artisan update：执行数据库迁移、清理视图与配置缓存等升级流程。
description.en: artisan update: runs migrations, clears view and config caches, and other upgrade steps.

description.zh: 数据库迁移与模型工厂：20 个迁移脚本从空库演进到当前表结构，工厂为测试生成用户/角色/材质。
description.en: Database migrations and model factories: 20 migrations evolve the schema from empty to current; factories seed users/players/textures for tests.

description.zh: 测试用工厂：UserFactory / PlayerFactory / TextureFactory 生成随机合法实体。
description.en: Test factories: UserFactory / PlayerFactory / TextureFactory generate random valid entities.

description.zh: 全量迁移：核心表（用户/角色/材质/衣橱/举报/通知/任务/scope/语言行）、积分与点赞字段、IP 扩容、OAuth 字段、暗色模式与材质宽度选项。
description.en: All migrations: core tables (users/players/textures/closet/reports/notifications/jobs/scopes/language lines), score and likes, IP widening, OAuth fields, dark mode and texture-width options.

description.zh: Dockerfile 生产镜像、.dockerignore、GitHub Actions（CI/Release/Telegram）、DevContainer 与 Gitpod 配置。
description.en: Dockerfile production image, .dockerignore, GitHub Actions (CI/Release/Telegram), DevContainer and Gitpod configs.

description.zh: 应用级服务装配：URL 生成与分页、视图组合器注册、Passport 作用域、事件映射与路由装载。
description.en: App-level service assembly: URL generation and pagination, view composer registration, Passport scopes, event mapping and route loading.

description.zh: 注册 cipher 与 Option 单例、配置分页器与 URL 生成器（站点 URL/强制 HTTPS/反向代理探测）。
description.en: Registers the cipher and Option singletons, configures the paginator and URL generator (site URL/force-HTTPS/proxy detection).

description.zh: ViewServiceProvider：为共享模板注册全部视图组合器与内联闭包（站点名、导航色、通知、语言、暗色模式、CDN）。
description.en: ViewServiceProvider: registers all view composers and inline closures for shared templates (site name, navbar color, notifications, languages, dark mode, CDN).

description.zh: 后端 PHPUnit（浏览器套件/控制器/中间件/命令/模型/监听器/服务）与前端 Jest（组件与脚本）测试。
description.en: Back-end PHPUnit (browser kit/controllers/middleware/commands/models/listeners/services) and front-end Jest (components and scripts) tests.

description.zh: 前端测试：组件与脚本的 Jest + Testing Library 用例，配置于 package.json。
description.en: Front-end tests: Jest + Testing Library cases for components and scripts, configured in package.json.

description.zh: 后端测试按域组织：HttpTest 控制器/中间件/视图、CommandsTest、ModelsTest、ListenersTest、ServicesTest、RulesTest。
description.en: Back-end tests organized by domain: HttpTest controllers/middleware/views, CommandsTest, ModelsTest, ListenersTest, ServicesTest, RulesTest.

description.zh: 站内信与邮件两条通道：SiteMessage 通知（队列）、邮件验证与找回密码邮件模板、管理员群发通知接口。
description.en: Two delivery channels: SiteMessage notifications (queued), email verification and password-reset mails, and the admin broadcast endpoint.

description.zh: 站内信收发：管理员群发、用户列表/标记已读、前端铃铛下拉；SiteMessage 通知走队列（ShouldQueue）写入通知表。
description.en: Site message delivery: admin broadcast, user list/mark-read and the front-end bell dropdown; SiteMessage is queued and stored in the notifications table.

description.zh: 邮箱验证与找回密码两封可本地化邮件（Mailable），支持 SMTP 配置、退订头与邮件视图。
description.en: Two localizable mails (verification and password reset) with SMTP config, list-unsubscribe headers and mail views.

description.zh: 以 options.php 文件为后端的键值配置：读取/写入与缓存、后台表单声明式构建器（OptionForm）及 option() 辅助函数与 Facade。
description.en: Key-value configuration backed by options.php: read/write with caching, the declarative admin form builder (OptionForm), and the option() helper plus Facade.

description.zh: 全部站点选项的默认值与中文说明：站点信息、注册与验证、积分规则、材质上传限制、插件市场与版权等。
description.en: Default values and docs for every site option: site info, registration and verification, score rules, texture limits, plugin market and copyright.

description.zh: 声明式后台表单 DSL：文本/复选框/选择器等控件、校验、按钮、提示与 before/after 回调，渲染为表单 HTML 并回写选项。
description.en: Declarative admin form DSL: text/checkbox/select controls, validation, buttons, hints and before/after callbacks, rendered to HTML and persisted.

description.zh: 基于 storage/options.php 的键值存储：读取（支持本地化值与原始值）、写入、全部导出，配合 Facade 与 option() 辅助函数。
description.en: Key-value store on storage/options.php: get (localized or raw), set, all, plus the Facade and option() helper.

description.zh: 角色名下的皮肤/披风绑定与改名删除，以及玩家的材质衣橱（收藏、应用、设为头像），含后台的跨用户衣橱管理。
description.en: Skin/cape binding, renaming and deletion for players, plus the per-user texture closet (favorite, apply, set as avatar), including admin-side closet management.

description.zh: 管理员查看全站角色、改名、转移归属、强制设置/清空材质与删除；前端为卡片列表加模态框。
description.en: Admin list of all players, rename, owner transfer, force-set/clear textures and delete; the front end is a card list with modals.

description.zh: 把皮肤库材质加入衣橱收藏、改名与移除，支持批量移除与把衣橱项设为头像/应用到角色。
description.en: Favorites texture-library items into the closet, with rename and removal (incl. batch), and supports applying items as avatar or to a player.

description.zh: 衣橱材质 ID 列表
管理员查看指定用户衣橱、代添加或移除衣橱项，用于处理异常收藏或违规内容。
description.en: Admin views a user’s closet and adds or removes items on their behalf, for handling broken favorites or violating content.

description.zh: 角色列表、新增、改名、删除与前端列表视图；角色名规则校验、同一玩家名不可重复，删除前广播事件。
description.en: Player list, add, rename, delete and the front-end list view; validates name rules and uniqueness, and fires events before deletion.

description.zh: Player 模型：与用户/皮肤/披风材质的关联、skin/cape 访问器、JSON 序列化与模型名称派生。
description.en: The Player model: user/skin/cape relations, skin and cape accessors, JSON serialization and derived model name.

description.zh: 给角色绑定或清空皮肤/披风材质，支持按名字自动搜索材质库；私有材质校验所有权。
description.en: Binds or clears the skin/cape texture of a player, supports searching the library by name; verifies ownership for private textures.

description.zh: 插件的发现、依赖校验、启用/禁用/删除、生命周期事件与资源拷贝，以及插件配置页、README 展示和插件市场。
description.en: Plugin discovery, dependency checks, enable/disable/delete, lifecycle events and asset copying, plus plugin config pages, README rendering and the plugin market.

description.zh: 插件管理页：启用/禁用、配置表单、README 展示、数据表、上传 zip 或按 URL 安装插件。
description.en: Plugin management page: enable/disable, config forms, README, data table, and install from a zip upload or URL.

description.zh: 命令行启用/禁用插件（plugin:enable / plugin:disable），便于脚本化运维。
description.en: Enable/disable plugins from the CLI (plugin:enable / plugin:disable) for scripted operations.

description.zh: 扫描 plugins 目录、读取 manifest、解析依赖与冲突、执行启用/禁用/删除并持久化启用列表；启动时按生命周期注册插件。
description.en: Scans the plugins dir, reads manifests, resolves dependencies and conflicts, performs enable/disable/delete and persists the enabled list; registers plugins on boot.

description.zh: 插件扫描/启停/依赖解析
从 registry 拉取插件元数据（本地化）、渲染市场列表并支持一键下载安装。
description.en: Pulls localized plugin metadata from the registry, renders the market list and supports one-click download and install.

description.zh: 单个插件的运行时视图：manifest 属性、静态资源 URL、README、配置类/视图与启停状态。
description.en: Runtime view of a single plugin: manifest attrs, asset URLs, README, config class/view and enabled state.

description.zh: 把 PluginManager 注册为单例并别名 plugins，应用启动时引导全部启用插件；配置文件声明插件目录与市场 registry。
description.en: Registers PluginManager as a singleton aliased plugins, boots all enabled plugins on startup; config declares the plugin dir and market registry.

description.zh: 密码哈希算法族（Cipher）、验证码与角色名校验规则、Passport OAuth2 scope 注册与缓存、角色中间件的权限判定依据。
description.en: Password hash algorithm family (Cipher), captcha and player-name validation rules, Passport OAuth2 scope registration and caching, and the role checks behind the role middleware.

description.zh: 可插拔的密码哈希实现（BCRYPT/ARGON2I/PHP_PASSWORD_HASH/MD5/SHA256/SHA512 及加盐变体），由 secure.cipher 选项选择，供登录校验与密码修改使用。
description.en: Pluggable password hash implementations (BCRYPT/ARGON2I/PHP_PASSWORD_HASH/MD5/SHA256/SHA512 and salted variants), selected via secure.cipher and used for login checks and password changes.

description.zh: Passport 作用域注册与缓存：内置 16 个用户/角色/衣橱/后台作用域，自定义 Scope 入库后刷新缓存供插件扩展。
description.en: Passport scope registration and caching: 16 built-in user/player/closet/admin scopes; custom Scope rows refresh the cache for plugin-defined scopes.

description.zh: 作用域与默认作用域注册
角色名规则：official 模式（大小写字母/数字/下划线、3-16 位）或自定义正则；验证码规则校验会话中的答案。
description.en: Player-name rule: official mode (letters/digits/underscore, 3-16 chars) or a custom regex; the captcha rule checks the session answer.

description.zh: 材质的存储、检索、上传与权限（公开性/类型/改名/删除），以及对外公开的材质与头像渲染接口（.json、raw、preview、avatar）。
description.en: Texture storage, search, upload and permissions (privacy/type/rename/delete), plus the public texture & avatar rendering endpoints (.json, raw, preview, avatar).

description.zh: 皮肤库主页、列表查询与详情展示：分页、按类型/关键词筛选、点赞与热度排序；前端为卡片列表与详情侧栏。
description.en: Skin library home, list query and detail: pagination, type/keyword filters, likes and popularity sorting; the front end is a card list with a detail sidebar.

description.zh: 上传者对自己的材质进行改名、改类型（steve/alex/披风）、改公开性（公开/私有）、删除；删除会广播事件并返还积分。
description.en: Uploaders rename, retype (steve/alex/cape), change privacy (public/private) and delete their own textures; deletion fires an event and refunds score.

description.zh: Texture 模型：哈希唯一键、类型与公开性字段、上传者关联、like 查询作用域与积分返还逻辑。
description.en: The Texture model: unique hash, type and privacy fields, uploader relation, the like query scope and score-refund logic.

description.zh: 材质实体与查询作用域
面向 Minecraft 客户端的高频只读接口：材质清单 JSON、原始材质二进制、头像与 2D 预览渲染。
description.en: High-frequency read-only endpoints for Minecraft clients: texture manifest JSON, raw binaries, avatars and 2D previews.

description.zh: avatar/player|user|hash|{tid}：把皮肤按正脸/头肩比例渲染为 PNG 头像，支持按角色名、用户、哈希或材质 ID 寻址。
description.en: avatar/player|user|hash|{tid}: renders the skin face/head-shoulder into a PNG avatar, addressable by player name, user, hash or texture ID.

description.zh: textures/{hash} 与 raw/{tid}：按内容哈希或材质 ID 返回原始皮肤/披风文件，带缓存头。
description.en: textures/{hash} and raw/{tid}: serve the raw skin/cape file by content hash or texture ID, with cache headers.

description.zh: 按 ID 返回材质文件
{player}.json 与 csl/{player}.json：返回角色皮肤/披风哈希与模型签名，供离线服务器插件拉取。
description.en: {player}.json and csl/{player}.json: return the skin/cape hash and model signature for a player, consumed by offline-server plugins.

description.zh: preview/{texture} 与 preview/hash/{hash}：把皮肤展开图渲染为 2D 预览 PNG，用于分享或嵌入。
description.en: preview/{texture} and preview/hash/{hash}: render the skin flatmap into a 2D preview PNG for sharing or embedding.

description.zh: 上传页面与提交处理：文件类型/尺寸校验、哈希去重、像素比例推断模型（steve/alex）、可选公开性；同时写入皮肤库与本地存储。
description.en: Upload page and submission: file type/size validation, hash dedup, model inference from pixel ratio (steve/alex) and optional visibility; writes both the library record and local storage.

description.zh: 账号全生命周期：登录/注册/找回密码/邮箱验证、个人资料与头像、积分与签到、站内通知、OAuth2 客户端管理及用户模型。
description.en: Full account lifecycle: login/registration/password reset/email verification, profile & avatar, score & daily sign-in, site notifications, OAuth2 client management and the user model.

description.zh: 登录、注册、找回密码、邮箱验证与验证码五条流程，覆盖页面渲染、表单提交、事件广播与邮件发送。
description.en: Five flows — login, registration, password reset, email verification and captcha — covering page rendering, form submission, event dispatch and mail delivery.

description.zh: 生成验证码图片并把答案写入会话，供注册/找回等表单通过 Captcha 规则校验。
description.en: Generates the captcha image and stores the answer in the session, validated by the Captcha rule in registration and reset forms.

description.zh: 注册后发送验证邮件，通过签名链接激活账号；未填邮箱的老账号被强制跳转到绑定页补齐邮箱。
description.en: Sends the verification mail after registration and activates the account via a signed link; legacy accounts without an email are forced to the binding page.

description.zh: 渲染登录页并按邮箱/角色名与密码校验，触发 UserTryToLogin、UserLoggedIn 事件，登出时清理会话。
description.en: Renders the login page and validates email/player name with password, firing UserTryToLogin and UserLoggedIn, and clears the session on logout.

description.zh: 通过邮箱发送带时效签名的重置链接，校验链接有效性后更新密码并清空会话，邮件模板可本地化。
description.en: Sends a signed, time-limited reset link by email, validates the link and updates the password while clearing sessions; the mail template is localizable.

description.zh: 渲染注册页并创建账号：昵称/邮箱唯一性与密码规则校验、初始积分、按 IP 限流与验证码校验，成功后广播 UserRegistered。
description.en: Renders the registration page and creates the account: nickname/email uniqueness and password rules, initial score, per-IP throttling and captcha, then fires UserRegistered.

description.zh: 用户中心概览：公告、积分与使用量卡片、角色与衣橱入口，同时提供当前用户的 API 接口。
description.en: User center overview: announcement, score and usage cards, player and closet entries, plus the current-user API endpoint.

description.zh: 用户自助管理已授权的第三方应用：查看、创建与撤销 OAuth 客户端，并渲染 Passport 授权确认页。
description.en: Self-service management of authorized third-party apps: list, create and revoke OAuth clients, plus the Passport authorization consent page.

description.zh: 资料页的展示与保存：昵称、邮箱、密码、头像与深浅色模式，含账号注销；数据校验与敏感操作二次确认。
description.en: Profile page display and saving: nickname, email, password, avatar and dark mode, plus account deletion; validation and confirmation for sensitive operations.

description.zh: 处理资料页渲染、字段更新（昵称/邮箱/密码）、头像上传缩放与深浅色切换，触发 UserProfileUpdated 事件。
description.en: Handles profile rendering, field updates (nickname/email/password), avatar upload & scaling, and the dark-mode toggle, firing UserProfileUpdated.

description.zh: 资料表单的 Twig 分片（头像/昵称/邮箱/密码/注销）与前端脚本，负责即时校验与交互反馈。
description.en: Twig partials for the profile form (avatar/nickname/email/password/delete-account) and the front-end scripts handling inline validation and feedback.

description.zh: 积分查询与每日签到：签到间隔、连续签到与奖励区间由选项配置，签到后写入历史并返回本次得分。
description.en: Score lookup and daily sign-in: interval, streak and reward range come from options; each sign-in is recorded and the awarded score returned.

description.zh: Twig/Blade 模板：共享布局（head/header/footer/sidebar/user-menu）、首页、表单组件、资源注入片段、错误页与邮件模板。
description.en: Twig/Blade templates: shared layout (head/header/footer/sidebar/user-menu), home page, form components, asset injection partials, error pages and mail templates.

description.zh: 后台整体布局（Twig 外壳 + Blade master）、页头脚本与资源编排。
description.en: Admin overall layout (Twig shell + Blade master), header scripts and asset orchestration.

description.zh: 为 app/home/spectre/style 四个入口生成资源引用片段（css/js/cdn），供页面按需加载构建产物。
description.en: Generates asset reference partials for the four entries (app/home/spectre/style), letting pages load built assets on demand.

description.zh: 登录/注册/忘记/重置/验证/绑定的 Twig 模板及其行级分片。
description.en: Twig templates for login/register/forgot/reset/verify/bind and their row-level partials.

description.zh: 可复用表单控件模板：文本、多行、复选、下拉、提示、按钮、分组与整体表单骨架。
description.en: Reusable form control templates: text, textarea, checkbox, select, hint, button, group and the form skeleton.

description.zh: 面向访客的首页：Hero 区、功能简介与登录注册入口。
description.en: Visitor-facing home page: hero section, feature intro and sign-in/up entries.

description.zh: 全局布局分片：head/header/footer/foot、侧边栏与菜单项、用户面板与菜单、通知铃铛、语言切换、暗色模式与版权。
description.en: Global layout partials: head/header/footer/foot, sidebar and menu items, user panel and menu, notification bell, language switcher, dark mode and copyright.

description.zh: 邮箱验证与找回密码两封邮件视图。
description.en: Mail views for email verification and password reset.

description.zh: 安装向导（欢迎/数据库/信息/完成）与安装锁定提示页模板。
description.en: Setup wizard (welcome/database/info/finish) and the install-locked notice templates.

description.zh: 皮肤库外壳、列表/详情/上传页与详情侧栏、上传输入控件。
description.en: Skin library shell, list/detail/upload pages, detail sidebar and upload input control.

description.zh: 用户中心布局（Twig 外壳 + Blade master）、角色页与衣橱页外壳。
description.en: User center layout (Twig shell + Blade master), player and closet page shells.

description.zh: 用户中心 Blade 布局
Blessing Skin 的外置登录插件：实现 Yggdrasil 服务端技术规范，配合 authlib-injector 让离线客户端用站点账号登录并拉取皮肤。
description.en: The external-login plugin for Blessing Skin: implements the Yggdrasil server spec, working with authlib-injector to let offline clients sign in with site accounts and fetch skins.

description.zh: Yggdrasil authserver 端点：authenticate/refresh/validate/signout/invalidate，校验站点账号密码并签发/刷新/吊销 accessToken。
description.en: Yggdrasil authserver endpoints: authenticate/refresh/validate/signout/invalidate, verifying site credentials and issuing/refreshing/revoking access tokens.

description.zh: 微软账号与站内账号的绑定能力：OAuth 授权链、绑定数据模型、用户中心与后台管理界面。
description.en: Microsoft-to-site account binding: OAuth grant chain, binding model, and user-center/admin UI.

description.zh: ygg_bindings 表与查询：按用户/角色名取官方 UUID，加密存取微软令牌，记录绑定与校验时间。
description.en: The ygg_bindings table and queries: look up the official UUID by user/player name, store Microsoft tokens encrypted, and track bound/verified times.

description.zh: 发起微软 OAuth 授权（MSA→XBL→XSTS→Minecraft Profile），回调后取得官方 UUID/角色名/令牌并写入绑定记录。
description.en: Runs the Microsoft OAuth grant (MSA→XBL→XSTS→Minecraft Profile), then stores the official UUID/name/tokens into the binding record.

description.zh: 绑定时与手动触发时，下载微软档案中的 ACTIVE 皮肤/披风，写入纹理库并应用到同名角色（不扣积分、私有纹理）。
description.en: On bind and on demand, downloads the ACTIVE skin/cape from the Microsoft profile, imports them into the texture library and applies them to the same-name player (free, private textures).

description.zh: 用户中心绑定/解绑页与后台绑定管理页，以及启动器配置引导（dnd 板块扩展）。
description.en: User-center bind/unbind page, admin binding management page, and the launcher-config guidance (dnd widget extension).

description.zh: 插件入口：配置日志通道、自动生成 RSA 私钥、注册 API 与后台路由、挂用户首页配置板块、后台菜单与日志页面，并按需注入 ALI 响应头中间件。
description.en: Plugin entry: configures the log channel, auto-generates the RSA private key, registers API and admin routes, mounts the user-home config widget and admin menu, and pushes the ALI header middleware when enabled.

description.zh: 启用回调：建表与默认选项

label.zh: 用 Hook 注册扩展点

description.zh: 插件配置页（UUID 算法/令牌有效期/限流/皮肤域名等）、API 根路径探测、后台 Yggdrasil 日志页与重新生成私钥按钮。
description.en: Plugin config page (UUID algorithm/token expiry/rate limit/skin domain), API root probe, admin Yggdrasil log page and the regenerate-key action.

description.zh: Yggdrasil 错误响应渲染：ForbiddenOperation/IllegalArgument/NotFound 按规范输出 error/errorMessage。
description.en: Yggdrasil error rendering: ForbiddenOperation/IllegalArgument/NotFound output error/errorMessage per the spec.

description.zh: 插件自身语言包（配置/拖拽/异常/前端/日志/中间件提示），支持简体中文与英文。
description.en: The plugin’s own language packs (config/dnd/exceptions/front-end/log/middleware hints) in Simplified Chinese and English.

description.zh: Yggdrasil 请求的前置处理：Content-Type 校验、暴力破解限流、ALI 兼容响应头。
description.en: Pre-flight handling for Yggdrasil requests: content-type check, brute-force throttling and the ALI-compatible response header.

description.zh: 为兼容旧版 authlib-agent 客户端注入 X-Authlib-Injector-API-Location 响应头（新协议已不需要）。
description.en: Injects the X-Authlib-Injector-API-Location header for legacy authlib-agent clients (no longer required by the new protocol).

description.zh: 校验请求 Content-Type 为 application/json，否则返回 415 错误。
description.en: Requires application/json content type, otherwise returns a 415 error.

description.zh: 按 IP/账号限制认证请求频率（ygg_rate_limit），防暴力破解密码。
description.en: Rate-limits authentication requests by IP/account (ygg_rate_limit) to prevent password brute force.

description.zh: P0/P1/P2 路径决策：健康检查与熔断、微软令牌在线校验、降级时用缓存的官方 UUID 本地签发。
description.en: P0/P1/P2 path decisions: health check and circuit breaker, online Microsoft token verification, and local signing with the cached official UUID on fallback.

description.zh: 认证入口决策：根据绑定状态与官方服务健康度选择 P0 离线 / P1 官方 / P2 兜底，维护熔断状态机。
description.en: Auth-entry decision: chooses P0 offline / P1 official / P2 fallback by binding state and official-service health, maintaining the circuit breaker.

description.zh: 用绑定令牌在线刷新微软凭据并核对官方 UUID/角色名（refresh→XBL→XSTS→profile），失败抛出可降级异常。
description.en: Refreshes Microsoft credentials with the bound token and verifies the official UUID/name (refresh→XBL→XSTS→profile); throws a degradable exception on failure.

description.zh: 按 UUID/名字查询角色档案并按需签名皮肤披风材质：profile/{uuid} 与 api/profiles/minecraft 批量查询。
description.en: Looks up profiles by UUID/name and signs skin/cape textures on demand: profile/{uuid} and api/profiles/minecraft batch query.

description.zh: Yggdrasil sessionserver 端点：join 记录进服状态并校验令牌与角色归属，hasJoined 供服务端查询玩家是否已登录。
description.en: Yggdrasil sessionserver endpoints: join records the session and verifies token/profile ownership; hasJoined lets servers check whether a player has logged in.

description.zh: clientToken/accessToken 的生成、查找、有效期（两次过期时间）与序列化，存储于 ygg_log 之外的令牌表。
description.en: clientToken/accessToken generation, lookup, dual expiry and serialization, stored in the token table alongside ygg_log.

description.zh: RSA 密钥生成（openssl 配置）、HTTP 请求/响应日志、UUID 生成（v3/v4）与 Minecraft 离线 UUID 派生。
description.en: RSA key generation (openssl config), HTTP request/response logging, UUID generation (v3/v4) and Minecraft offline-UUID derivation.

label.zh: 用 Hook 注册扩展点

reading.zh: 按领域阅读：从左到右依次是请求入口 → 业务域 → 平台能力 → 表现层与交付面。点开任一模块继续下钻到单一功能单元。
reading.en: Read by domain: request entry → business domains → platform capabilities → presentation and delivery. Open any module to drill down to a single functional unit.

reading.zh: 仪表盘是总览，用户/举报是管控操作，选项与更新是站点配置。
reading.en: Dashboard is the overview, users/reports are governance, and options/update configure the site.

reading.zh: 用户提交举报，管理员在队列中审核。
reading.en: Users submit reports; admins review them in the queue.

reading.zh: 列表提供数据入口，联系信息与账户处置逐项操作。
reading.en: The list is the data entry; contact and account operations follow.

reading.zh: 事件目录与 Hook 是扩展面，调度表把事件路由到监听器，形成插件可挂接的闭环。
reading.en: The catalog and Hook form the extension surface; the dispatcher routes events to listeners, closing the plugin loop.

reading.zh: 三类响应：材质衣橱联动、插件资源同步、用户事件。
reading.en: Three response groups: texture/closet, plugin assets, and user events.

reading.zh: 五类事件：菜单路由、渲染挂载、角色、用户、插件生命周期。
reading.en: Five event kinds: menu/route, render mounts, player, user, and plugin lifecycle.

reading.zh: 异常先经渲染器分类，再落到对应错误页模板。
reading.en: Exceptions are classified by the renderer and then fall through to the matching error page template.

reading.zh: 运行时装配基础能力，组件库与 hooks 供页面复用，终端与样式独立成区。
reading.en: Runtime assembles base capabilities; the component library and hooks are shared; terminal and styles stand alone.

reading.zh: 终端会话承载窗口，命令集负责执行。
reading.en: The session hosts the window; commands handle execution.

reading.zh: 五类通用组件：模态、分页、预览、反馈、表单。
reading.en: Five component kinds: modal, pagination, viewer, feedback, form.

reading.zh: 入口引导 → 路由匹配 → 网络层与状态总线支撑页面。
reading.en: Entry boot → route matching → HTTP layer and state bus support pages.

reading.zh: 请求自左向右穿过中间件栈进入路由，控制器取数后由视图组合器喂给模板。
reading.en: A request flows left to right through the middleware stack into routing; controllers fetch data and composers feed the templates.

reading.zh: 三个组合器分别负责页头资源、页脚脚本与导航菜单数据。
reading.en: Three composers handle head assets, footer scripts and navigation menu data.

reading.zh: 按执行顺序阅读：全局预处理 → 安装闸门 → 登录态 → 权限与验证。
reading.en: Read in execution order: global preprocessing → installation gate → authentication → verification and roles.

reading.zh: 从左到右：装载器读取三张路由表，装载后向插件广播扩展事件。
reading.en: Left to right: the loader reads the three route tables, then fires the extension event for plugins.

reading.zh: 语言包资源经加载器进入应用，语言探测选择当前语言，后台管理回写词条。
reading.en: Language packs load through the loader, detection picks the locale, and admin writes entries back.

reading.zh: 从引导与装配出发，命令行与数据层支撑运行时，构建/CI/测试保障交付。
reading.en: From bootstrap and assembly, the console and data layer support runtime; build/CI/tests ensure delivery.

reading.zh: Webpack 打包、URL 生成与依赖清单构成前端工程化的三件套。
reading.en: Webpack bundling, URL generation and manifests form the front-end tooling triad.

reading.zh: 内核注册命令，安装/升级/缓存/盐/插件命令各行其职。
reading.en: The kernel registers commands; install/update/cache/salt/plugin commands each do their job.

reading.zh: 迁移定义表结构，工厂为测试造数。
reading.en: Migrations define the schema; factories seed test data.

reading.zh: 两个装配器分别负责应用级单例与视图组合器。
reading.en: Two assemblers: app-level singletons and view composers.

reading.zh: 后端 PHPUnit 与前端 Jest 双轨测试。
reading.en: Back-end PHPUnit and front-end Jest run in parallel tracks.

reading.zh: 站内通知走队列与页面下拉，邮件通道独立发送。
reading.en: Site notifications go through the queue and the bell; mail sends independently.

reading.zh: 默认值 → 存储服务 → 表单构建器，形成选项的读写闭环。
reading.en: Defaults → store service → form builder close the option read/write loop.

reading.zh: 从角色模型出发，向左是用户侧的管理与材质绑定，向右是衣橱及其后台管理入口。
reading.en: From the player model: user-side management and texture binding on the left, closet and its admin entry on the right.

reading.zh: 从提供者引导出发：管理器与实体是内核，后台与市场是操作面，命令用于脚本化。
reading.en: From the provider: manager and entity form the core; admin and market are the UI; commands support scripting.

reading.zh: 密码哈希、OAuth 作用域与输入规则构成安全三件套。
reading.en: Password ciphers, OAuth scopes and input rules form the security triad.

reading.zh: 上传者经皮肤库与材质管理维护数据，最终由公开渲染接口向 Minecraft 客户端输出。
reading.en: Uploaders maintain data via the library and management; the public rendering endpoints serve Minecraft clients.

reading.zh: 从左到右按数据形态：清单 JSON → 原始文件 → 头像 → 预览。
reading.en: Left to right by data shape: manifest JSON → raw files → avatars → previews.

reading.zh: 左侧是账号入口与生命周期流程，中间是登录后的用户中心能力，右侧是模型与授权底座。
reading.en: Left: account entry and lifecycle flows. Middle: signed-in user center features. Right: the model and authorization foundation.

reading.zh: 按账号生命周期从左到右：注册（含验证码）→ 登录 → 邮箱验证 → 找回密码。
reading.en: Left to right along the account lifecycle: register (with captcha) → login → email verification → password reset.

reading.zh: 控制器负责校验与落库，视图分片负责表单与前端交互。
reading.en: The controller validates and persists; the view partials render forms and front-end interactions.

reading.zh: 共享布局与表单组件是通用底座，认证/用户/皮肤库/后台/安装/邮件是各页面家族。
reading.en: Shared layout and form components are the common base; auth/user/skinlib/admin/setup/mail are the page families.

reading.zh: 客户端请求先过协议中间件，进入认证/会话/档案端点；绑定与官方路由为已绑定用户提供官方 UUID 与容灾切换。
reading.en: Client requests pass protocol middleware into the auth/session/profile endpoints; binding and official routing provide bound users with the official UUID and failover.

reading.zh: OAuth 客户端取得官方档案，模型持久化，皮肤同步与界面提供自助服务。
reading.en: The OAuth client obtains the official profile, the model persists it, and skin sync plus UI provide self-service.

reading.zh: 请求依次通过 Content-Type 校验、登录限流，出站时注入 ALI 头。
reading.en: Requests pass the content-type check, then login throttle; the ALI header is injected outbound.

reading.zh: 路由决策器选择路径，校验器负责在线核对官方档案。
reading.en: The router picks a path; the verifier checks the official profile online.

title.zh: 双向容灾官方认证（绑定式官方档案）
